overall_goal: Clean up the workspace, manage ingredients, and transfer chopped vegetables to bowls.

goals.rationale: The person turns on the tap, rinses their hands, and dries them with a cloth.

goals.description: Prepare the scale and read the recipe
goals.rationale: The person moves the recipe card, grabs the scale, places a colander on it, and reads the recipe.
The person opens the fridge to get a plant-based burger and a box of mushrooms.

goals.description: Manage mushroom boxes and recycle packaging
goals.rationale: The person puts a mushroom box back in the fridge, then breaks down an empty mushroom box and throws the cardboard and plastic into their respective recycling bins.

goals.description: Transfer sliced mushrooms to a bowl
goals.rationale: The person moves sliced mushrooms from the chopping board into a bowl, picking up any slices that fall on the counter.

goals.description: Clean up potato peels and peeler
goals.rationale: The person gathers potato skins from the chopping board and floor, and taps the peeler to clean it.

goals.description: Rearrange items on the kitchen counter
goals.rationale: The person turns the chopping board and moves the recipe card and plastic colander to make space.

goals.description: Clean hands and knife from onion bits
goals.rationale: The person wipes onion bits off their hands using a knife, then washes and dries their hands.

goals.description: Retrieve ingredients and tools for cooking
goals.rationale: The person opens drawers and the fridge to get tomato puree, butter, and a small bowl.

goals.description: Transfer chopped onion to a small bowl
goals.rationale: The person pushes chopped onions from the chopping board into a bowl and gathers any spilled pieces from the counter.

goals.description: Dispose of food waste into the bin
goals.rationale: The person gathers onion and potato peels from the counter and floor, opens the food waste bin, and throws the peels inside.
